user.title: Connect Solar AI Optimizer
user.description: Enter the Solar AI Optimizer URL and a short-lived pairing code from Settings → Home Assistant connection.

data_description.host: Base URL of Solar AI Optimizer (for example http://192.168.1.50:8000).
data_description.pair_code: One-time code from the Solar pairing UI. Fail-safe entities and thresholds are configured after setup via Configure.

hassio_confirm.title: Solar AI Optimizer app discovered
hassio_confirm.description: Do you want to configure Home Assistant to connect to the Solar AI Optimizer app: {addon}?

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Solar AI Optimizer
reconfigure.description: Update the Solar host URL or SSL verification. Pairing credentials are kept.

data_description.host: Base URL of Solar AI Optimizer reachable from Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Solar AI Optimizer
reauth_confirm.description: Generate a new pairing code in Solar and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Solar AI Optimizer.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Provide a valid pairing code.

abort.already_configured: This Solar install is already configured.
abort.missing_install_id: The host did not report an install ID, so Home Assistant cannot confirm it is the same Solar install. Check the host URL and try again.
abort.supervisor_managed: This integration uses Supervisor-managed authentication. The supervisor token is handled by Home Assistant automatically — no re-pairing is required.
abort.wrong_install: The host belongs to a different Solar install.

init.title: Fail-safe options
init.description: Configure Home Assistant entities used when Solar heartbeat becomes stale. Set both fail-safe entities or neither.

data_description.grid_charge_enable: Optional inverter switch turned on when heartbeat is stale beyond debounce.
data_description.max_grid_charge_current: Optional inverter number entity set to max amps on fail-safe.
data_description.stale_seconds: Maximum age of the Solar heartbeat pulse before the install is unhealthy.
data_description.debounce_seconds: How long the heartbeat must remain stale before the fail-safe latches.

update_failed.message: Unable to install Solar AI Optimizer update: {error}

failsafe_incomplete.title: Fail-safe configuration incomplete
failsafe_incomplete.description: Both a grid-charge enable switch and a max grid-charge current number entity are required for the fail-safe watchdog. Go to Settings → Devices & Services → Solar AI Optimizer → Configure → Options and set both entities, or clear both.

confirm.title: Open Configure → Options to fix fail-safe
confirm.description:
Go to **Settings → Devices & Services → Solar AI Optimizer**, click **Configure**, and open the **Options** step. Set **both** the grid-charge enable switch entity and the max grid-charge current number entity, or clear both — configuring only one is not allowed.

After saving options with both entities set (or cleared), this issue will close automatically.

failsafe_cleared_verify.title: Fail-safe cleared — verify inverter settings
failsafe_cleared_verify.description: The Solar AI heartbeat has recovered and the fail-safe latch has been cleared. Solar will reclaim inverter control automatically. Verify your inverter settings are correct and dismiss this notice once confirmed.

confirm.title: Verify inverter settings
confirm.description:
The Solar AI heartbeat has recovered and the fail-safe watchdog has cleared its latch. Solar will resume automatic inverter control.

Before dismissing: confirm your inverter's grid-charge switch and current settings are in the expected state. Solar does **not** revert the values it set during the fail-safe.

failsafe_amps_fallback.title: Fail-safe used default grid-charge current
failsafe_amps_fallback.description: The fail-safe activated but the max grid-charge current was not available from the Solar config at that time. The built-in default was used instead. Confirm Solar is reachable and check the Solar config (`max_grid_charge_a` in `/api/config`) to ensure the correct current limit is set.

confirm.title: Check Solar config
confirm.description:
The fail-safe activated but could not read the max grid-charge current from Solar (the built-in default of 60 A was used instead).

To avoid recurrence:
1. Confirm Solar is reachable from Home Assistant.
2. Check the Solar config (`max_grid_charge_a` in `/api/config`) to ensure the correct current limit is set — this is not configured in the HA integration options.

Dismiss once you have verified Solar is connected and the current limit is correct.
